name: Trustlocal Widgets
author: Trustlocal

sections.description:
Trustlocal Widgets – Display your Trustlocal Score and reviews on your website

With this plugin, it’s easier than ever to install the Trustlocal Widgets on your WordPress website. Retrieve the code from your Trustlocal Dashboard, install the plugin, and place widgets such as the Trustlocal Score Widget and the Trustlocal Review Widget anywhere on your site.

Trustlocal Score Widget

This widget adds an icon with your company’s Trustlocal Score to your website. Visitors immediately see your business is highly rated, which builds trust and strengthens your reputation.

Trustlocal Review Widget

Your business probably gets reviewed on different platforms: Google, Trustpilot, Facebook or industry-specific sites. Wouldn’t it be great to show them all in one place? The Trustlocal Review Widget automatically gathers your customer reviews and displays them right on your website.

Features

  • Three Widget Types: Score Widget, Score + Google Widget, and Review Widget
  • Gutenberg Blocks: Visual block editor with live preview and customization options
  • Shortcode Support: Easy-to-use shortcodes for posts, pages, and widgets
  • Display the widgets anywhere on your website
  • Show star ratings in Google search results
  • Increase your company’s visibility and credibility
  • Easily adjust the design to match your website via your Trustlocal Dashboard or custom HTML
  • Works in every browser and on mobile
  • Straightforward installation process
  • Also available as Shortcode and Gutenberg Blocks

Widget Types

  1. Score Widget – Display your Trustlocal score
  2. Score + Google Widget – Score widget with Google integration
  3. Review Widget – Display customer reviews

How does it work?

After installing and activating the plugin:

Request your API key in the Trustlocal Dashboard and use the handy sliders to match the design with your website and branding. Download the plugin in WordPress, paste the code, and you’re done. The widget will instantly appear on your website. In your Trustlocal Dashboard, you can select exactly what you want to display.

  1. Go to Settings → Trustlocal Widgets
  2. Enter your Trustlocal API Key
  3. Add widgets using Gutenberg blocks or shortcodes

Shortcodes

  • [trustlocal_score] – Score Widget
  • [trustlocal_score_google] – Score + Google Widget
  • [trustlocal_reviews] – Review Widget

Customization

All widgets support customization through attributes:

[trustlocal_score theme=”dark” size=”large”]
[trustlocal_reviews theme=”dark”]

Third-Party Services

This plugin integrates with Trustlocal services to display widgets on your website.

What is Trustlocal?

Trustlocal is a third-party service that aggregates and displays business ratings, reviews, and scores from multiple platforms. The service provides widgets that can be embedded on websites to showcase customer feedback and ratings.

What is it used for?

This plugin uses Trustlocal services to:
* Display business scores and ratings
* Show customer reviews from multiple platforms
* Display Google ratings alongside Trustlocal scores
* Provide customizable widgets that match your website’s design

What data is sent and when?

API Authentication (Backend)
* When: During plugin activation, API key validation, and when accessing the admin settings page
* Data Sent: Your API key (used for authentication only)
* Purpose: To verify your API key and retrieve your account information (client ID, provider name, country code)

Note: No personal user data is collected or sent. Only Trustlocal account identifiers and widget configuration preferences are transmitted.

Privacy and Terms

  • Privacy Policy: EN | DE | BE | ES
  • Terms of Service: EN | DE | BE | ES

By using this plugin, you agree to Trustlocal’s privacy policy and terms of service.
sections.installation:
In your Trustlocal Dashboard

  1. Log in to your Trustlocal Dashboard, click Website Widgets, and select the widget you want to place on your website.
  2. Adjust the widget to your preferences, such as theme, display options, and style.
  3. Click WordPress Plugin and copy the generated key.

In your WordPress Dashboard

  1. Go to Dashboard → Plugins → Add New Plugin
  2. Search for Trustlocal Widgets
  3. Click Install
  4. Paste the API code from your Trustlocal Dashboard
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Place the widget anywhere on your site
sections.faq:
How do I install the plugin?

Follow the installation instructions or watch the instruction video for a visual walkthrough.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is completely free with a Trustlocal account.

Can I change how the widget looks on my website?

Yes, you can easily adjust the design in your Trustlocal Dashboard (colors, style, and layout) so it perfectly matches your site.

Can I choose which reviews are shown?

Yes, you decide which reviews appear on your website.

Do I need a Trustlocal account to use the widget?

Yes, creating and managing the widget is only possible with a Trustlocal profile. Sign your company up in just a few minutes.

The widget isn’t working / I can’t install the plugin

If you need help installing the plugin, simply schedule a session with our customer service team. We’ll guide you step by step through installation or help fix any issues. Make sure you’re logged in to both your Trustlocal Dashboard and your WordPress Dashboard.
